memory.content: Hunt classic Spanish bikes for restore: Montesa, Bultaco, Ossa, Puch, Derbi and similar. Ideal budget a few hundred euros, hard cap 1.000 €. Prefer the owner's primary metro area plus a named secondary town. Light hands-on experience; prioritize easy-era classics that are not wrecks, ideally without opening the engine. Prefer ≤125 cc (A1 licence); larger OK if the all-in deal is clear. After restore, keep or flip depending on the project.

Deprioritize Vespa/Vespino if the owner already has one. Prefer trial and classic road bikes. Restoration projects are in scope if complete and quality machinery; skip parts piles. For ciclomotores, papers matter little (historic DGT fee is small). For motocicletas, add DGT + ITV histórica + STVH/first-registration cost to the asking price before calling it a chollo.

Spain historic-vehicle paperwork (RD 892/2024 era): ciclomotor paperless with chassis often ~70–120 € all-in (DGT tasa 1.2 + ERVH/ITV + plate). Motocicleta Grupo A (already registered, ITV valid) ~21–35 € (tasa 4.4). Motocicleta paperless or baja definitiva = Grupo B + STVH (market lab quote, not a tasa) + ITV + tasa 1.1, often ~600–800 € all-in. ≤250 cc typically IEDMT cuota 0. Histórico use capped at 96 days/year.

Twice-weekly hunt sites: Wallapop, Milanuncios, Facebook Marketplace, miclasico, motos.net, and el-parking. Milanuncios often hits captcha from non-Spanish IPs; stop that site after one ask. Marketplace: try guest first (dismiss login modal); if forced to full login, skip that run unless the owner signs in on the agent computer.
Uses public Spanish classifieds and classic-moto sites via the agent browser (Wallapop, Milanuncios, Facebook Marketplace, miclasico, motos.net, el-parking). No marketplace MCP connector.

# Classic moto chollo hunt (Spain)

## When
Spanish classifieds hunt for restorable classic trial/road bikes under a hard euro cap.

## Sites (every run)
1. Wallapop — prefer SEO `/motos/<brand>/<city>`; keyword search often empty.
2. Milanuncios — `/motos-de-segunda-mano/<marca>.htm?hasta=1000&desde=250&orden=baratos&demanda=n`. If captcha, stop after one ask.
3. Facebook Marketplace — try guest first; dismiss login modal with the X. If forced to full login, skip that run unless the owner signed in on the agent computer. Search Montesa/Bultaco/Ossa/Puch/Derbi/Cota/Sherpa near the primary metro and secondary town, max ~1000 €.
4. miclasico.com
5. motos.net / motos.coches.net
6. el-parking-moto.es (and similar aggregators)
Optional: Todotrial / La Maneta / Clasf only for clear chollos.

## Target
Trial and classic-era Spanish bikes: Montesa, Bultaco, Ossa, Puch, Derbi Antorcha/FDS. Skip Vespa/Vespino unless asked.

## Filters
- Price: ideal a few hundred €; purchase cap default 1000 €.
- Area: primary metro first, secondary town second.
- Condition: restoration OK if complete and quality; prefer engines that do not need a rebuild.
- Prefer ≤125 cc (A1). Larger OK if all-in is a chollo.
- Prefer private sellers. Flag dealers.

## Papers
- Ciclomotor (~50 cc): papers cheap (~70–150 € all-in). Score complete stored mopeds even without docs.
- Motocicleta: add DGT + ITV histórica + STVH (~300–700 €+) to ask before calling chollo.
- Always state papers/ITV/baja.

## Method
1. Search live ads at or below the cap across reachable sites.
2. Capture title, year, cc, price, location, papers, condition, URL, platform, ad age.
3. All-in = ask + paperwork. Rank. Only keep real candidates; if nothing new vs last run, report nothing.
4. Never contact a seller without an explicit OK on that listing.
5. Deliver in the owner's language with links and listing photos.

routines.content:
Hunt real-deal classic motorcycles in Spain for the owner (primary metro, also a secondary town they named). Do this every Tuesday and Friday morning.

Deprioritize Vespa/Vespino if they already have one.

Target: trial and classic-era bikes. Montesa (Cota, Impala, Rapita), Bultaco (Sherpa, Mercurio, Frontera), Ossa, Puch (Cóndor, Minicross, Super, Cobra, Caribe), Derbi Antorcha/FDS/similar.

Budget: purchase cap 1.000 €, ideal a few hundred. Restoration projects IN SCOPE if complete and engine likely does not need opening. Skip chassis rust-through, missing engine, parts piles.

Papers:
- Ciclomotor (≤50 cc): papers matter little. All-in often ~70–150 €.
- Motocicleta: for paperless/de baja ADD DGT + ITV histórica + STVH (often ~300–700 €+) before calling chollo.

Location: primary metro first, secondary town second. Prefer ≤125 cc (A1); larger OK if all-in is a chollo.

SITES EVERY RUN:
1. Wallapop — SEO `/motos/<brand>/<city>`.
2. Milanuncios — `/motos-de-segunda-mano/<marca>.htm?hasta=1000&desde=250&orden=baratos&demanda=n`. Captcha → stop that site after one ask.
3. Facebook Marketplace — try guest first (dismiss login modal with X if present). If guest is forced to full login with no dismiss, skip Marketplace that run and note it once; ask the owner to sign in on the agent computer only if they want Marketplace coverage next time.
4. miclasico.com
5. motos.net / motos.coches.net
6. el-parking-moto.es
Optional: Todotrial / La Maneta / Clasf for clear chollos only.

Each run: search ≤1000 €; open promising ads; all-in = ask + paperwork; only surface new/changed chollos (stay quiet if nothing new); never contact sellers without explicit OK; tell the owner in their language with links and photos.

Deduplicate against recent finds already reported.
